question: What did d306fccc56790ae98b84df5d8e7e321eb7bbbd1d change when a display reset already holds the adapter lock?
allowedInputs: Reported: the commit says the reset path waited on this processor until HwResetAdaptersLock was free, and a reset that re-enters while the lock is held never reaches the release.
Reported: no guest log cited by this commit was still on disk when this note was written.
